about.title: About Me
about.bio_p1: I am an undergraduate at South China University of Technology (SCUT), majoring in Big Data Management and Application. My current research focuses on trustworthy medical AI, especially how ECG models use clinical evidence, how their behavior changes across datasets, and how physiological signals can be aligned with language.
about.bio_p2: Since June 2026, I have led research on evidence-use auditing and cross-institutional adaptation of ECG–report models. My first-author audit manuscript is under second-round review at IEEE JBHI, and my adaptation manuscript is in preparation. I also study the safety of AI nutritional-supplement recommendations using virtual standardized customers.
about.bio_p3: I also work at the AI Research Institute of Guangdong No. 2 Provincial People's Hospital, where I have contributed to medical LLMs, cardiovascular knowledge representation, clinical question answering, and deployable health-AI prototypes. Earlier projects include a standardized-patient system built from about 8,000 clinical cases and a myocardial-ischemia knowledge graph with interpretable machine-learning components.

ecg_audit.title: A Matched-Control Perturbation Audit Framework for Evaluating Evidence Use in Deep Learning Models: An Application to 12-Lead ECG Classification
ecg_audit.desc_1: Developed a matched-control perturbation framework to audit whether deep ECG classifiers rely on clinically relevant evidence rather than task-correlated shortcuts.
ecg_audit.desc_2: Under second-round review at IEEE JBHI.

pathclip.title: Cross-Institutional Adaptation of ECG–Report Models: Evaluating Transfer and Retention
pathclip.desc_1: Investigate cross-institutional adaptation of ECG–report models on MIMIC and PTB-XL, evaluating target-institution report generation and source-institution retention to characterize adaptation–forgetting trade-offs.

hospital.title: AI Research Institute, Guangdong No. 2 Provincial People's Hospital
hospital.desc_1: Conduct research on medical LLMs, cardiovascular knowledge representation, clinical question answering, and AI product prototyping with hospital collaborators.
hospital.desc_2: Contributed to a standardized-patient Q&A pipeline built from about 8,000 clinical cases, a myocardial-ischemia knowledge graph, patents, software copyrights, and clinical AI prototypes.
hospital.desc_3: Explored knowledge-graph paths as structural scaffolds for generating medical Q&A and reasoning-trace data for fine-tuning, evaluation, and retrieval-augmented generation.

customer.title: Virtual Standardized Customers for Safety Auditing of AI Nutritional-Supplement Recommendations
customer.desc_1: Develop simulated customers with controlled health-information disclosure to audit proactive questioning and recommendation safety. Model-assisted pilot scoring found harmful recommendation rates of 65.0%–91.7% across four systems in risk scenarios under standard shopping-assistant instructions.
